blocks.html: The underlying yard regulations of Section 62-33 (Special Yard and Lot Regulations on Waterfront Blocks), inclusive, shall apply. In addition, where a waterfront yard is not required pursuant to Section 62-33, yards meeting the dimensional requirements of Section 62-332 (Rear yards and waterfront yards) shall be provided in connection with any development, in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (f) of Section 62-912 (Elements of a Waterfront Access Plan).
